turns.text: For six months both of my feet have burned at night.
My doctor said my blood work was normal but I do not have the records.
I think my TIBC was 305 but I am not sure.
I also get heat in my face on both sides after foods I call inflammatory.
There is some mild discomfort under my right ribs too.
It starts an hour or more after eating and lasts an hour or two.
Position and activity do not change it.
Let's not deal with the burning feet.
There is a delay like I said. What do you think I should do? I don't have any more labs.
